_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Happy are those whose transgression is forgiven.
Today salvation has come to this house.
Zacchaeus, hurry down; I must stay at your house today.
Today salvation has come to this house.
Wash, make clean; learn to do good, seek justice.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: A small, despised man climbs a tree just to see, and Jesus stops and calls him by name.
Today salvation has come to this house.
Come down, I must stay with you — and grace walks straight into a house everyone avoided.
Today salvation has come to this house.
The change is real: half to the poor, fourfold to the cheated, a life turned right-side up.
Today salvation has come to this house.
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost — which is to say, came for us.
Today salvation has come to this house!
